test_quaternion_to_xyz_euler: test the quaternion_to_xyz_euler function by converting quaternions back to Euler angles and checking for NaN values
test_multiply: test the multiply function by multiplying two quaternions and comparing the result to matrix multiplication
test_blend: test the blend function by blending multiple quaternions with optional weights and verifying gradient flow
